title: How fast carbon dioxide rose at Mauna Loa, by decade
description: Bar chart of the average yearly rise in carbon dioxide at Mauna Loa, in parts per million a year, averaged by decade from NOAA's annual growth rates: 1960s, 0.86; 1970s, 1.28; 1980s, 1.61; 1990s, 1.51; 2000s, 1.97; 2010s, 2.42; 2020 to 2025, 2.56. Averages worked out for kloom from NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory data.
heading: MAUNA LOA · CO₂ RISE A YEAR · PPM
